programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! - No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people - from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I simply cannot wait for more!

programme.title: Of Boats And Men
programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: Some of the proof of Einstein's theories had long been elusive, beyond the capabilities of technology, until now. It appears that Einstein is once again triumphant with the latest in deep space observations.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: We're looking hard, but the numbers aren't stacking up. Is life on other planets really that hard to find? Does it even exist? We have not discovered so much as a signal, so maybe we really are alone in our neck of the galaxy.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: Did you know the potato chip was invented out of anger? Or that "Sweet 'N Low" was named after a song? Or the real truth of why we say "God Bless You" after a sneeze? These questions and more are answered and explained in a new series called "Wow, I Never Knew That!" from Executive Producer Whoopi Goldberg, Tom Leonardis and the Emmy award- winning production company David Harris Katz Entertainment, Inc. "Wow I Never Knew That!" is a whimsical, half-hour television series that is jam-packed with exciting tidbits and fascinating facts that uncover the truths and origins behind the stuff you're already familiar with. From the items you use every day to the phrases you use in conversation to the habits you're so accustomed to, you'll be fascinated to learn how they've all really come about!

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Plastic has become ubiquitous. Impressive, since we'd been living without them for centuries! We have grown dependent on plastics in many ways. The production industry uses it to connect the parts that make machinery: our trillions of toilet bowls need it, let alone wash machines, computers, toothbrushes, pens and traffic lights. Can you imagine that plastic was accidentally invented for the purpose of making billiard balls? Though, its inventor had used something now called guncotton, which led to a rather explosive game of pool. In the end, the first plastic was discovered when someone witnessed how Southeast Asian farmers used the poop of a little beetle, called shellac, to preserve wood. When looking for a substitute, Leo Beakeland created "Bakelite" and that substance turned out to be the first plastic. Nylon followed, the first man-made synthetic plastic, developed by Dupont to replace silk. Nylon isn't that difficult to make yourself, amazingly. During WW2 all nylon production went into the manufacturing of parachutes, leading Dupont and others to stop producing pantyhose. It led to true nylon riots. Plastics were plain out popular. Indeed, the age of plastic had only just begun. But plastic is made with oil and is hard to break down, which calls for a solution. A company in the US is creating a bioplastic grown inside microorganisms. In fact - soon they'll have plants cultivating plastic… plastic grown in the field? Now that is quirky!

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Infestation
programme.desc: Water covers 71% of the Earth's surface and is the medium of life. All life forms and their surrounding ecosystems are dependent upon water, without it we would cease to exist. Director of Notre Dame's Environmental Change Initiative, Dr. David Lodge examines the infestations that are spreading throughout our fresh and salt water systems and clogging our precious waterways.

programme.title: Д'Артаньян и три мушкетера
programme.desc: Приключенческий музыкальный телесериал, снятый по мотивам одного из самых знаменитых романов Александра Дюма "Три мушкетера". Четверо друзей - гасконец Д'Артаньян и мушкетеры Атос, Портос и Арамис - спасают честь королевы Франции, вступают в единоборство со всесильным кардиналом Ришелье и коварной Миледи, а главное - наслаждаются жизнью.

programme.title: Волшебник Изумрудного города. Дорога из желтого кирпича
programme.desc: Во время урагана, который наколдовала злая колдунья Гингема, девочка Элли и её преданная собачка Тотошка перенеслись в волшебную страну. Ураган уронил на Гингему их домик на колёсах. Элли одела туфельки, что остались от колдуньи, и отправилась искать волшебника. Чтобы вернуться домой она должна найти трёх друзей. Вместе с Тотошкой они встречают: Страшилу, мечтающего получить мозги, железного дровосека уверенного, что у него нет сердца, а оно ему просто необходимо и Трусливого Льва. Которому нужна храбрость. По желтой кирпичной дороге компания отправляется в Изумрудный город, где должен жить волшебник, исполняющий заветные желания.

programme.title: Эмбер Алерт
programme.desc: Поездка превращается в опасную игру после встречи с машиной, связанной с тревогой о похищенном ребёнке.

programme.title: Королевство кривых зеркал
programme.desc: Девочка Оля вечно не слушалась свою бабушку, капризничала, ленилась, вечно всего боялась. И вот однажды... Благодаря старому волшебному зеркалу Оля встречается с собственным отражением – девочкой Яло. Обе они попадают в Королевство кривых зеркал, где вообще нет обычных зеркал, потому что злые и не очень честные обитатели королевства желают казаться лучше, чем они есть на самом деле. Девочки, в конце концов, побеждают Зло, а для Оли, к тому же, путешествие в зазеркалье дало отличную возможность взглянуть на себя со стороны и приобрести прекрасные человеческие качества – самоотверженность, бесстрашие, верность друзьям…

programme.title: Друг на продажу
programme.desc: Гоша и Ваня - друзья с детства. Когда-то они сидели за одной партой, а теперь Иван - честный и неподкупный сотрудник ГИБДД, а Гоша - бизнесмен, готовый иногда идти на не вполне законные компромиссы. Когда у Гоши из-за его невнимательности прогорает его очередной бизнес, а от Вани уходит девушка, Гоше приходит в голову гениальная идея, с помощью которой всё можно исправить. Ничего не сказав Ивану, его друг публикует на сайте знакомств объявление, в котором Ваня представлен как мачо-миллионер, ищущий вторую половинку. За свидание с \"миллионером\" Гоша, как представитель брачного агентства, берет комиссию - 5 тысяч рублей, ну а дальше... все проблемы только начинаются.

programme.title: Секретный агент
programme.desc: Она — секретный агент мирового уровня. На этот раз ее задача — предотвратить биологическую атаку на Лондон. Вовлеченная в большую шпионскую игру, она неизбежно сталкивается с миром двойных стандартов, паранойи, безнаказанности и предательства. Вокруг так много друзей, но кому из них на самом деле можно доверять? И кто из них тот неуловимый "крот", которого она должна вычислить, чтобы остановить террористов? Чтобы спасти Лондон, ей самой придется играть не по правилам.

programme.title: Ночная смена
programme.desc: Макс теряет работу на заводе и, чтобы прокормить семью, вынужден согласиться на неожиданное предложение бывшей одноклассницы - поработать стриптизером. Скрывая новую профессию от жены Ани, Макс попадает в массу удивительных и нелепых ситуаций и в итоге теряет доверие любимой женщины. Стремясь вернуть мир и гармонию в семью, он обращается за помощью к коллегам из стрип-клуба, что и вовсе приводит к веселому хаосу...

programme.title: Кукушка
programme.desc: Сентябрь 1944 года, несколько дней до выхода Финляндии из Второй Мировой войны. Финскому снайперу-смертнику Вилле, прикованному к скале, удается освободиться от цепей. Капитан Советской армии Иван арестован СМЕРШем, и тоже только чудом остается в живых. Солдат враждующих армий приютила у себя на хуторе девушка Анни. Ни советский капитан, ни финский снайпер еще не знают, что Финляндия заключила перемирие с СССР и вышла из войны. Но для Анни они не враги, а просто мужчины. И все трое говорят на разных языках... Награды XXIV Московского Международного Кинофестиваля: Серебряный "Святой Георгий" Александру Рогожкину за лучшую режиссерскую работу, Серебряный "Святой Георгий" Виллэ Хаапасало за лучшую мужскую роль, приз ФИПРЕССИ за лучший фильм.

programme.title: Бар "МоскваЧики"
programme.desc: Вика, Соня и Карина теряют устойчивое положение в Москве. Чтобы развеяться и подумать о будущем подруги уезжают в Петербург. После бурной ночной тусовки девушки, неожиданно для себя, покупают бар в историческом доме. Единственное неудобство - на втором этаже заведения находится квартира, а в ней своенравный жилец, который отказался выехать. Близкое знакомство с ним превращается в жестокое противостояние хозяек заведения и трёх молодых людей, у которых есть одна тайна на всех. Девушки очень не хотят отказываться от своего детища - бара \"МоскваЧики\", но сложностей с ним больше, чем они предполагали...

programme.title: Морфий
programme.desc: Февраль 1917 года. Выпускник медицинского факультета Михаил Алексеевич Поляков получает назначение в земскую больницу. Новый доктор не совсем уверен в себе еще и потому, что до приезда сюда он потерпел неудачу в любви. Однажды, борясь за жизнь пациента, Поляков ставит под угрозу свою. Спасает его укол морфия - самого сильного наркотика. Молодой врач уверен, что пагубное пристрастие обойдет его стороной. По рассказам Михаила Булгакова.

programme.title: Shoreditch
programme.desc: In London 1939, before the beginning of the Second World War, Thomas and his wife Massie run the Say When jazz club. But when he starts having an affair with singer Butterfly, their world disintegrates into blackmail, drugs, and suicide.

programme.title: Love Is Not Enough
programme.desc: Samir, must face his parent's breakup. While they meet to find the way to tell him, the little Samir surprises them, because he knows perfectly what's happening, putting his own parents into a hard place with his vision of the situation.

programme.title: Spooner
programme.desc: Facing eviction from his parent's home on his 30th birthday, a socially awkward guy meets the girl of his dreams and creates his own rules for growing up.

programme.title: Nico the Unicorn
programme.desc: A 12-year-old disabled boy, whose father recently passed away, has his life changed when the pony he rescues gives birth to a unicorn. Can he save the unicorn from the people who want to exploit it?

programme.title: Digging Into China
programme.desc: Harriet, a ten-year old girl, lives together with her big sister and her alcoholic mother out in the countryside. The family runs a motel. Harriet is different from the others, as she owns a great creativity and has nobody to play with. Her infinite world exists only in her mind. One day, Ricky comes along. He is a grown-up, but retarded son of an elderly lady. Soon, Harriet and Ricky share their experiences of life from a different point of view and become close friends. But his mother still plans to give Ricky away into professional care in a home, because she won't live forever to be there for him.

programme.title: Uncle Nino
programme.desc: A distant, slightly dysfunctional family is brought closer together when the father's long-estranged Uncle Nino comes from Italy to Chicago for a surprise visit.

programme.title: Prince and Me 2: The Royal Wedding
programme.desc: The Prince and Me 2: The Royal Wedding continues the story of 2003's fantasy romance The Prince and Me. In the earlier film, Paige (Julia Stiles) - a midwestern college co-ed - falls in love with Edvard (Luke Mably), sans realizing that he is actually the Prince of Denmark. In this sequel, Paige (now played by neophyte Kam Heskin) and Eddie must confront a centuries-old Danish edict declaring that if a Danish prince marries a commoner, he must abdicate his throne. C

programme.title: See You in September
programme.desc: See You in September is an original romantic comedy set in current day Manhattan. The film centers around Lindsay, a beautiful woman who seemingly has it all, but is deeply afraid of commitment. When she finds out that her therapist takes a vacation for the entire month of August she feels shocked and abandoned. Instead of taking this news lying down, Lindsay enlists the help of her acerbic best friend Monica to come up with a solution. With the assistance of "Craig's List", Lindsay puts together a group therapy session for all Manhattanites who are in need of therapy, but more importantly angry at their therapists for abandoning them.

programme.title: Almost Friends
programme.desc: Charlie, a culinary genius, has lost the motivation. He doesn't know what to with his life anymore, but he knows one thing - get close to Amber. In comparison to her boyfriend, he seems to be totally unattractive, but Charlie's closest friend convinces him that where there's a will there's a way.

programme.title: Con Man
programme.desc: The story of Barry Minkow, a young charismatic business man who becomes a wealthy CEO by lying, cheating and stealing his way to the top.

programme.title: Talea
programme.desc: Summertime. Everybody is excited to go on vacation to Italy. Everybody but Jasmin. Jasmin is yearning something. She wants to be with Eva, her mother, from whom she had to live seperately for a long time. For weeks, Jasmin is trying to get close to Eva. She does not give up, even if she's rejected. After an argument, Jasmin runs away from her fosterhome and convinces Eva to leave the city together and go on a trip. The two get closer -- sometimes as friends, sometimes as mother and daughter. A first joint cigarette, a dance in the village disco, wanderings through the woods. But expectations and needs of the girl and her mother are diverging repeatedly, especially when a man attracts Eva's attention and disturbs the growing closeness between mother and daughter.

programme.title: That Trip We Took with Dad
programme.desc: This comedy drama tells the story of a Romanian-German family caught up in the political turmoil of 1968. They start a journey from the city of Arad to the German Democratic Republic, where the older son, Mihai hopes that surgical intervention for his ailing father will restore the family's harmony. Accompanied by Emil, the younger brother, they are caught in the aftermath of the Prague Spring, which alters their plans. Suddenly, they find themselves on the other side of the Iron Curtain in West Germany. In just a few hours, they have to decide: to stay or to go back home?

programme.title: Fighting Season
programme.desc: On the brink of the 2007 U.S. troop surge, two Army Recruiters face the daunting pressures of recruitment while their own deployment is on the line. Sgt. Harris has been stationed in the recruiting office long enough for it to feel like home. On the other side of the world, a roadside bomb rips through a Humvee, and after recovering from the attack, Sgt. Mason gets reassigned and winds up in Harris's office. Mason wants to go back to the front lines, but he finds out that the war isn't confined to the battlefield.

programme.title: Falcon Rising
programme.desc: FAVELA, the first installment in the CODENAME: FALCON franchise, introduces former marine John "Falcon" Chapman, a dark anti-hero driven by guilt and suffering from post-traumatic stress disorder, who will destroy himself unless given something else to destroy - a useful weapon-of-last-resort for the U.S. State Department. When Chapman's sister is brutally attacked while on assignment in Brazil, Chapman flies into Sao Paulo to track down her assailants, quickly entering the city's seedy underbelly and discovering a world of drugs, the sex trade, corrupt cops, and organized crime syndicates battling for control.

programme.title: The Humanity Bureau
programme.desc: In the near future, war, climate and political agendas have robbed America of its lush resources. Seeds rarely grow into vegetation, the water is mostly polluted, and people are obligated to work hard to earn their keep. Noah Kross (Nicolas Cage) is an agent of "the Humanity Bureau," a government agency that determines a person's productivity. Kross's reports are key factors in deciding who stays in America and who is deported to New Eden. Kross is in charge of managing the deportation of a former governor of Colorado who now lives in misery, who claims to know "the truth" before seeking to kill Kross and then being shot by him. Kross ends up discovering that New Eden is really an extermination camp where the excess unproductive population is liquidated and incinerated.

programme.desc: Filmzone'i filme tutvustavad treilerid.

programme.title: Seks ja linn 2
programme.desc: Ülemaailmse kassahiti järg on teravmeelne romantiline komöödia, mille aluseks samanimeline menuseriaal. Carrie, Samantha, Charlotte ja Miranda on tagasi, et astuda vastu uutele väljakutsetele, mida meeste ja naiste omavahelised suhted pidevalt esitavad. Mis juhtub pärast seda, kui öeldakse altari ees "jah"? Elu pakub kõike seda, mida need neli naist eales tahta oskasid, aga saatusel on alati varuks mõni üllatus. Käesoleval juhul on selleks glamuurne ja päikeseküllane seiklus ühte kõige luksuslikumasse ja elavamasse paika maamuna peal, kus pidu ei lõpe iial. Selline põgenemine reaalsuse eest tuleb nelja parima sõbra jaoks just õigel hetkel, kui nad katsuvad jõudu erinevate rollidega nagu ema, abikaasa ja palju muudki. Film ei sobi alaealistele.

programme.title: Maja võidab alati
programme.desc: Komöödia tele-esilinastus! Naabrimehe Franki (Jason Mantzoukas) abiga otsustavad nad tema majas põrandaaluse kasiino avada.

programme.desc: Anonüümne noormees alustab kättemaksukampaaniat korrumpeerunud juhtide vastu, kes tapsid tema ema ja rõhuvad vaeseid ning jõuetuid.

programme.title: Soosik
programme.desc: Iirimaa, Suurbritannia,USA 2018 komöödia, draamaLavastaja:Yorgos LanthimosOsades:Emma Stone, Rachel Weisz, Nicholas Hoult18. sajandi hakul on pea kõik Inglismaa mehed hõivatud üksteise mahanottimisega Hispaania pärilussõjas. Kummalisel kombel haigestunud kuninganna Anne (Veneetsia festivalil parima naisnäitleja auhinna võitnud Olivia Colman) igavleb luksuslikus palees oma voodis. Tema naeruväärse imetluse on pälvinud 17 armsat jänkukest ja ta osaleb alati ekstravagantsetel meelelistel üritustel, kuid lükkab olulisemad kohustused oma ustava sõbranna Sarah (Oscari-võitja Rachel Weisz) kaela. Marlborough' hertsoginna kutsub palee toateenijaks veetleva, kuid ujeda nõbu Abigaili (Oscari-võitja Emma Stone). Petlikuna näiv kuninglik rahu ja peomeeleolu ei jää aga kauaks kestma, kui need kolm kuritahtlikku ja kalki naist hakkavad tunnetama armastuse varjatud piire eri moel.

programme.title: Armastuse teekond
programme.desc: Ellie on kaua ja kaunikesti aidanud oma õel pulmi planeerida. Külalised on vaikselt rannahotelli kokku kogunema hakanud, kuid keda kohal pole on pruutpaar. Juhtumisi on isameheks Ellie ekspeika Greg, kellega tuleb nüüd kiirelt plaab B välja mõelda, et külalised maha rahustada. Pulmapäev läheneb ohtliku kiirusega. Ellie ja Greg peavad kriisiolukorras tihedat koostööd tegema ja ühtäkki hakkavad nad taasavastama, miks nad ise kunagi teineteisesse nii armunud olid.

programme.desc: USA 2018 animatsioon, seikluskomöödia Lavastaja: Wes Anderson Osades(hääled): Frances McDormand, Greta Gerwig, Scarlett Johansson, Bryan Cranston, Edward Norton, Tilda Swinton, Jeff Goldblum, Liev Schreiber, Bill Murray, Harvey Keitel, Ken Watanabe "Koerte saar" on lugu 12-aastasest Atari Kobayashist, kelle eestkostjaks on korrumpeerunud meer Kobayashi. Kui linnapea dekreediga küüditatakse kõik Megasaki City koerad tohutule prügimäele, kihutab Atari oma Junior-Turbo propellerlennukiga Prügisaarele, et päästa oma neljajalgne ihukaitsja Täpi. Koos uute krantsidest sõpradega asub Atari eepilisele teekonnale, millega määratakse terve Prefektuuri tulevik.

programme.title: Aeg, mis alles jääb
programme.desc: Moefotograaf, kellel on diagnoositud surmaga lõppev vähk, otsustab surra üksi. Ta valmistab oma lähedasi ette eluks pärast tema lahkumist, selle asemel et püüda vältimatut keemiaraviga pikendada või lasta end ümbritseda kaastundest nende poolt, kes tema haigusest teavad.

programme.title: Elu maitsed
programme.desc: Lugu staažikast kokast Eugeniest ja Dodinist, gurmeekokast, kelle juures ta viimased 20 aastat töötanud on.

programme.title: Taasleitud armastus
programme.desc: Noor lesknaine naaseb esimest korda kolme aasta jooksul koju, et aidata korraldada oma õe pulmi. Ta on sunnitud silmitsi seisma oma minevikuga, sealhulgas mehega, kellesse ta kunagi ei arvanud armuvat.

programme.title: Täidetud lubadused
programme.desc: Hazel on ürituste korraldaja, kes peab organiseerima oma õele täiuslikud pulmad vähem kui kuu ajaga. Ja just siis selgub, et ajalooline võõrastemaja ja armastatud pulmapaik Rosewood, kus ka Hazeli ja ta õe vanemad abiellusid, on müügis...

programme.title: Segadus kontoris
programme.desc: Lacey suurim unistus on töötada reklaaminduses. Veidrate asjaolude kokkusattumisel pakutakse talle vale inimese pähe unistuste tööd. Kõik läheb ülesmäge, ta leiab armastuse töökaaslasega, kuid kardab, et kaotab kõik, kui tema tegelik identiteet paljastatakse.

programme.title: Emma Fieldingi müsteeriumid: Eelnevalt nägemata
programme.desc: Hiilgav arheoloog Emma Fielding on võtnud eesmärgiks tõestada oma isa teooriat, et tema kodulinnas on olnud iidne asundus. Ta viib grupi õpilasi arheoloogilisele väljakaevamisele. Kui väljakaevamiselt leitakse surnukeha, peab Emma Fielding politseiniku abiga müsteeriumit lahendama hakkama. Pärast ootamatut leidu ilmuvad välja rivaalid, kes teda üle trumbata tahavad ja ka ülikool avaldab igal sammul survet.

programme.title: Igavene Valentin
programme.desc: Kui õnnetu baarikaklus pöörab Wyomingu puhkekeskuse ühiskondliku töö tandriks, avastavad suurlinnatüdrukud Julia ja Sydney ootamatu missiooni, mis muudab nende mõlema elu igaveseks.

programme.title: Minu bossi pulmad
programme.desc: Kui Kimberley kihlub Bradleyga, paneb ta pulma korraldama oma assistendi Nicole'i, kes õnnetuseks vihkab pulmi kogu hingest. Kui välja ilmub aga Kimi kompu noor sugulane, hakkab susisema hoopis uus noor armastus.

programme.title: Armastuse salaretsept
programme.desc: Leah ja Jonas on pärit täiesti erinevatest maailmadest: Leah peab väikest maheturgu ning Jonas on kuulus kokandusmaailma ja tõsielusarja staar. Kui mõlema karjäärid ühel hetkel ristteele jõuavad, tekib neil võimalus teineteisele tööalaselt abiks olla. Kas nad suudavad suruda alla oma uhkuse ja kalduvuse töönarkomaaniale, et leida üheskoos tasakaalu töö- ja eraelus?

programme.title: Семейные мелодрамы
programme.desc: Это не выдуманные истории, а реконструкция реальных событий, которые могут случиться с каждой семьей. В каждой семье свои "Семейные мелодрамы", конфликты, накопившиеся проблемы с долговыми ямами, изменами, трудными детьми и конфликтами с родителями. Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

programme.title: Женский доктор
programme.desc: Действие разворачивается в новой современной клинике, которую основал профессор Юрий Климов. Бывшему тестю доктора Романа Широкова остался лишь год до выхода на пенсию, и за это время он должен найти достойного преемника. Но это не главная причина, по которой профессор вновь приглашает Романа работать вместе. Роман Широков – единственный, кто может довести до конца инновационную научную разработку, от которой зависит судьба дочери профессора - Нины. Однако инвесторы и сотрудники клиники не рады появлению нового профессионала.

programme.title: Верная подруга
programme.desc: В жизни учительницы музыкальной школы Кати Смолиной случается непоправимое – в автомобильной аварии погибает ее муж, Андрей. Лучшая подруга, которая находилась с ним в одной машине, в тяжелом состоянии попадает в реанимацию. Катя забирает дочку Инны, семилетнюю Машу, в свой дом. Сама Катя не может иметь детей и тем тяжелее она переживает гибель мужа – у нее ничего не осталось от их любви. Кроме того, свекровь осыпает ее постоянными упреками и обвиняет Катю в смерти Андрея – ведь именно она уговорила мужа отвезти подругу в оздоровительный лагерь к заболевшей Маше. А вскоре Катя узнает, что ее муж и лучшая подруга были любовниками…

programme.title: Дневники Темного
programme.desc: Телеканал ТЕТ подготовил для вас нечто очень неожиданное. Проект придется по вкусу всем любителям загадочных мистических историй. События происходят в фантастическом городе Темный. В нем живут вампиры, оборотни и другие существа. Все здесь живет и дышит, даже стены домов. Попасть в этот загадочный город совсем не сложно, а вот покинуть - невероятно сложно. Однажды в город приезжает журналист. Его задача - освещать события, происходящие в Темном. Однако все осложняется тем, что отличить где правда, а где только галлюцинации, в городе бывает невероятно трудно. В каждом выпуске он расследует новые мистические дела. Удастся ли ему раскрыть их и спасти жизни людей? Сможет ли журналист выжить в таинственном городе? А выбраться из него? - Узнавайте в мистическом сериалы "Дневники Темного".

programme.title: It Should Not Had Happened

programme.title: Battles BC
programme.desc: Step back in time and revisit some of the most brutal battles that took place before Christ. Recreated with stunning technology, we reveal these violent conflicts like never before, examining the soldiers, strategies and weapons deployed by the powerful legions. From Hannibal's clashes with Rome to Alexander the Great's pursuits throughout India, these conflicts have had a resounding impact on our history and with these reconstructions you will see the ferocious aspects of war in antiquity.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Thousands of people from every part of the world have reported being abducted by aliens, including even a world leader - President Kirsan Ilyumzhinov of the Russian Republic of Kalmykia, who announced in 2007 that he had been taken aboard an extraterrestrial ship. Could the alien abduction phenomenon be true? But if so, why are people being taken? And perhaps more importantly - why are they being returned?

programme.title: Unidentified: Inside America's UFO Investigation
programme.desc: In December of 2017, The New York Times published a stunning front-page exposé about the Pentagon's mysterious UFO program, the Advanced Aerospace Threat Identification Program (AATIP). Featuring an interview with a former military intelligence official and Special Agent In-Charge, Luis Elizondo, who confirmed the existence of the hidden government program, the controversial story was the focus of worldwide attention. Previously run by Elizondo, AATIP was created to research and investigate Unidentified Aerial Phenomena (UAP) including numerous videos of reported encounters, three of which were released to a shocked public in 2017. Elizondo resigned after expressing to the government that these UAPs could pose a major threat to our national security and not enough was being done to deal with them or address our potential vulnerabilities. Now, as a part of HISTORY's groundbreaking new six-part, one-hour limited series UNIDENTIFIED: INSIDE AMERICA'S UFO INVESTIGATION, Elizondo is speaking out for the first time with Tom DeLonge, co-founder and President of To The Stars Academy of Arts & Science and Chris Mellon, former Deputy Assistant Secretary of Defense and Intelligence, to expose a series of startling encounters and embark on fascinating new investigations that will urge the public to ask questions and look for answers. The series will reveal newly authenticated evidence and footage, interviews from eyewitnesses and former military personnel who have never spoken out before, and extensive breakthroughs in understanding the technology behind these unknown phenomena in our skies.

programme.title: UFO Hunters
programme.desc: The team's access to UFO evidence is unparalleled and their expertise allows them to quickly identify bogus claims of UFOs. Together, they use eyewitness accounts, scientific experimentation, documents recently released through the Freedom of Information Act and footage that has never been seen before on television to piece together compelling — and at times chilling — evidence of UFO phenomena. Join UFO Hunters Bill Birnes, Pat Uskert, Dr. Ted Acworth, and Jeff Tomlinson as they separate fact from fallacy.

programme.title: UFO Files
programme.desc: In the search for life beyond our planet, this documentary investigates areas on earth that are said to have had UFO activity, conspiracy theories and phenomenons. Interviewing a variety of scientists and experts on UFOs and examining when possible evidence can prove or suggest anything towards super natural life. From going off of tales that have been told and spread through generations and or cultures to personal experiences where sighting have occurred the series covers the super natural phenomenon that is life beyond earth.

programme.title: UFO Hunters

programme.title: Cities of the Underworld
programme.desc: He was the ringleader behind some of the most notorious murders in history. He terrified the world and plunged the city of Los Angeles into a state of paranoia and fear. He's Charles Manson, and the deserts around Los Angeles were his home... and he hoped the underground would be his haven. But Manson and his followers weren't the only things lurking beneath the streets of LA. We'll take you beneath the most congested streets in America, into the tunnels where corrupt cops ran the city in secret and the largest subway system in the world lays in waste. From earthquakes to UFOs, this city has to be ready for anything. But with military bunkers protecting our shores and subterranean disaster relief war rooms, LA's underground also holds the key to its survival.

programme.title: Project Impossible
programme.desc: Project Impossible is an original series that follows a new generation of epic engineering projects that were considered unthinkable just a few years ago. Each episode of Project Impossible features multiple stories that illustrate man-made projects that are crucial to our future. These projects include a massive North Sea wind station with 600-foot rotors, a giant sea wall that will protect the ancient city of Venice from rising waters, the world's largest moveable structure in Chernobyl, and the construction of a fleet of nuclear powered icebreaking ships.

programme.title: Project Impossible
programme.desc: Project Impossible is an original series that follows a new generation of epic engineering projects that were considered unthinkable just a few years ago. Each episode of Project Impossible features multiple stories that illustrate man-made projects that are crucial to our future. These projects include a massive North Sea wind station with 600-foot rotors, a giant sea wall that will protect the ancient city of Venice from rising waters, the world's largest moveable structure in Chernobyl, and the construction of a fleet of nuclear powered icebreaking ships.

programme.title: Battles BC
programme.desc: Step back in time and revisit some of the most brutal battles that took place before Christ. Recreated with stunning technology, we reveal these violent conflicts like never before, examining the soldiers, strategies and weapons deployed by the powerful legions. From Hannibal's clashes with Rome to Alexander the Great's pursuits throughout India, these conflicts have had a resounding impact on our history and with these reconstructions you will see the ferocious aspects of war in antiquity.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Thousands of people from every part of the world have reported being abducted by aliens, including even a world leader - President Kirsan Ilyumzhinov of the Russian Republic of Kalmykia, who announced in 2007 that he had been taken aboard an extraterrestrial ship. Could the alien abduction phenomenon be true? But if so, why are people being taken? And perhaps more importantly - why are they being returned?

programme.title: Unidentified: Inside America's UFO Investigation
programme.desc: In December of 2017, The New York Times published a stunning front-page exposé about the Pentagon's mysterious UFO program, the Advanced Aerospace Threat Identification Program (AATIP). Featuring an interview with a former military intelligence official and Special Agent In-Charge, Luis Elizondo, who confirmed the existence of the hidden government program, the controversial story was the focus of worldwide attention. Previously run by Elizondo, AATIP was created to research and investigate Unidentified Aerial Phenomena (UAP) including numerous videos of reported encounters, three of which were released to a shocked public in 2017. Elizondo resigned after expressing to the government that these UAPs could pose a major threat to our national security and not enough was being done to deal with them or address our potential vulnerabilities. Now, as a part of HISTORY's groundbreaking new six-part, one-hour limited series UNIDENTIFIED: INSIDE AMERICA'S UFO INVESTIGATION, Elizondo is speaking out for the first time with Tom DeLonge, co-founder and President of To The Stars Academy of Arts & Science and Chris Mellon, former Deputy Assistant Secretary of Defense and Intelligence, to expose a series of startling encounters and embark on fascinating new investigations that will urge the public to ask questions and look for answers. The series will reveal newly authenticated evidence and footage, interviews from eyewitnesses and former military personnel who have never spoken out before, and extensive breakthroughs in understanding the technology behind these unknown phenomena in our skies.

programme.title: UFO Hunters
programme.desc: The team's access to UFO evidence is unparalleled and their expertise allows them to quickly identify bogus claims of UFOs. Together, they use eyewitness accounts, scientific experimentation, documents recently released through the Freedom of Information Act and footage that has never been seen before on television to piece together compelling — and at times chilling — evidence of UFO phenomena. Join UFO Hunters Bill Birnes, Pat Uskert, Dr. Ted Acworth, and Jeff Tomlinson as they separate fact from fallacy.

programme.title: UFO Files
programme.desc: In the search for life beyond our planet, this documentary investigates areas on earth that are said to have had UFO activity, conspiracy theories and phenomenons. Interviewing a variety of scientists and experts on UFOs and examining when possible evidence can prove or suggest anything towards super natural life. From going off of tales that have been told and spread through generations and or cultures to personal experiences where sighting have occurred the series covers the super natural phenomenon that is life beyond earth.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: From The History Channel : "Myths and legends have long been regarded as fantastic stories that describe powerful gods, mutant giants and fearsome monsters. But why do so many different cultures, separated by vast distances, tell the same stories? Is it possible that myths and legends were really eyewitness accounts of ancient astronauts descending to Earth? Ancient texts are filled with stories of gods interacting with humans, offering wisdom, technology, and even impregnating women. Could the demigods of mythology have been the offspring of alien and human unions? If so, could aliens have supplied the Missing Link that accelerated human evolution, advancing our civilization and making us who we are today?"

programme.title: Cities of the Underworld
programme.desc: While most people think of San Francisco as a haven for peace-loving hippies, this city by the Bay is actually one of the biggest military defense installations in America. We'll take you beneath its picturesque hills and uncover the biggest ammunitions depot on the West Coast before plunging into a deadly arsenal that once stored nuclear missiles with more than six times the destructive power of the atom bomb dropped on Hiroshima. From the secret Civil War fortification buried beneath Alcatraz to the human trafficking tunnels winding below Chinatown, San Francisco's underground is evidence of its sordid past.

programme.title: Project Impossible
programme.desc: Project Impossible is an original series that follows a new generation of epic engineering projects that were considered unthinkable just a few years ago. Each episode of Project Impossible features multiple stories that illustrate man-made projects that are crucial to our future. programme.title: Clash of the Gods
programme.desc: Documentary series that in each episode explains the heroic and tragic life of various figures from Greek and Norse mythologies - the most powerful monsters, heroes and Gods, including Thor, Hercules, Beowulf, Minotaur, Odysseus and Zeus. Was ancient Greece's greatest hero Hercules a real person? What inspired the Minotaur's labyrinth? Did Odysseus's famous journey really happen? This series will answer these and many other questions, and experts will connect the myths we all know to actual historical events, and link the stories to mythologies of other cultures as well.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

programme.title: Lost Worlds
programme.desc: Documentary series that brings back to life lost cities, structures, cultures, and civilisations, transporting viewers back in time and revealing the truth behind some of history's most iconic eras. Using a combination of cutting-edge technology and archaeological research, the team detail what life was like for these places during their peak of their powers, and use visual overlays to compare past and present landscapes. From the Knights Templar to the lost city of Atlantis, ancient Egypt to Hitler's planned supercity, and ancient Athens to America's wild west, each episodes dives into these extraordinary remnants of human history.

programme.title: Bible Secrets Revealed
programme.desc: Documentary series in which viewers have a chance to explore the mysteries and reveal secrets and hidden facts of the world's most famous and oldest book - the Bible. For thousands of years, The Holy Bible has been the foundation on which Judaism and Christianity are built, but there are still many secrets and things which can be interpreted differently. Featuring stunning on-location photography, interesting reenactments and interviews with scientists, archaeologists and religious leaders, this series will take us on remarkable journey back in time to see what the Old Testament and the New Testament are hiding from us - from Dead Sea Scrolls, examinations of the traditional belief that Moses wrote the Torah, to whether Adam and Eve were created together or one before the other, who authored the New Testament and many other mysteries.

programme.title: Digging for the Truth
programme.desc: Digging for the Truth was a History Channel television series. The first three seasons of the show focused on host Josh Bernstein, who journeyed on various explorations of historical icons and mysteries. Bernstein is the president and CEO of BOSS and has a degree in anthropology and psychology from Cornell University. The show airs every Monday night at 9:00 EST on the History Channel. The series premiered in January, 2005 and has since become the highest-rated series in the history of The History Channel, which was surprising given the previous show "Time Titans" from the production crew never made it past the pilot. The third season premiered on January 22, 2007, with a 2-hour special event on the quest for Atlantis. Bernstein announced on February 20, 2007, that he would be leaving The History Channel and Digging for the Truth, and would, as of April, join The Discovery Channel as an executive producer and host of a new prime-time series and specials. Hunter Ellis, host of Tactical to Practical and Man, Moment, Machine for The History Channel, then replaced Josh Bernstein as host.

programme.title: Азия 360
programme.desc: Что вы знаете о Центральной Азии? То, что эти страны когда-то входили в состав СССР, и то, что люди сейчас там живут бедно, живут в кишлаках и ездят на ослах, мечтают переехать в Россию и работать там, пьют только зеленый чай и едят плов и мясо, притесняют людей других национальностей? Мы решили развеять самые распространенные мифы о Центральной Азии, а также рассказать о забытых традициях и блюдах, которые шокируют иностранцев, а иногда даже самих местных.

programme.title: Два с половиной человека
programme.desc: Закоренелый холостяк Чарли, постоянно опасающийся за свою свободу, и его брат Алан, недавно разошедшийся с женой, живут под одной крышей. Чарли только и делает, что заводит любовные интрижки, а Алан всеми силами пытается от него не отстать. В свободное от амурных приключений время братья воспитывают десятилетнего сынишку Алана Джейка.

programme.title: Два с половиной человека
programme.desc: Закоренелый холостяк Чарли, постоянно опасающийся за свою свободу, и его брат Алан, недавно разошедшийся с женой, живут под одной крышей. programme.title: Доживем до понедельника
programme.desc: Учитель истории Мельников много размышляет, строго и требовательно спрашивает. Ему знакомы и сомнения, и моменты усталости, и неудовлетворенность. И Мельников не всегда прав. Но он борется, ищет, любит, преодолевает трудности и сомнения. Один из лучших советских фильмов о школе, о сложных взаимоотношениях учеников и педагогов, о том, как важно встретить в жизни настоящего Учителя...

programme.title: Чемпионат Европы по водным видам спорта
programme.desc: С 10 по 16 августа в Париже будут разыграны медали чемпионата Европы по плаванию в 50-метровом бассейне. В программе предварительных заплывов: 400 м, комплекс, мужчины; 100 м, вольный стиль, женщины; 50 м, баттерфляй, мужчины; 200 м, спина, женщины; 100 м, брасс, мужчины; эстафета, 4х200 м, вольный стиль, женщины; эстафета, 4х200 м, вольный стиль, мужчины; 800 м, вольный стиль, женщины. В соревнованиях примут участие эстонские пловцы Ральф Трибунцов, Даниэль Зайцев, Алекс Ахтиайнен, Кристофер Палвадре, Ральф Роозе и Кристьян Рейварт. Комментирует трансляцию Дмитрий Пютсепп.

programme.title: Неизвестная Россия
programme.desc: Город Обоянь - маленький населенный пункт в Курской области. До границы с Украиной - 60 километров. И три-четыре пока еще работающих предприятия. Главный источник дохода взрослого мужского населения Обояни - грузоперевозки. Такой концентрации грузовиков, прицепов и рефрижераторов нет, наверное, ни в одном населенном пункте России. Потому и прозвали Обоянь "городком дальнобойщиков". Хотя ни в одном туристическом путеводителе его найти не удастся.

programme.title: Азия 360
programme.desc: В отдаленном селе Зардалы Баткенской области живут 30 семей, в основном это пожилые люди. Село находится в 10 километрах от районного центра, но до сих пор здесь нет электричества, дороги, а люди добираются в село по опасной горной тропе, зимой нередко срывались с обрыва. Местное население все еще ждет, когда их обеспечат светом и связью и построят безопасную дорогу. В августе 1999 года здесь произошло самое крупное военное столкновение с боевиками ИДУ. Жители были взяты в заложники почти на месяц. Покажем быт людей и расскажем о воспоминаниях событий 20-летней давности. И еще расскажем о том, как этот поселок стал признанным на мировом уровне самым экологичным районом, где выращивают экопродукты.

programme.title: Встречная полоса
programme.desc: Автомобильная авария переворачивает жизнь Крапивиных навсегда. Игорь попадает в больницу с сильной травмой головы, а его жене Любе открывается шокирующая правда. Оказывается, ее любимый муж ей изменяет. Об этом Люба узнает из сообщений, которые приходят на телефон Игоря от его молодой любовницы Ники. Люба оказывается перед серьезным выбором — открыть ли правду об измене мужа семье? Нужно ли признаться любовнице мужа, что Люба в курсе их отношений? И, наконец, как поступить — бороться за жизнь Игоря или бросить его?

programme.title: Госпожа Фазилет и ее дочери
programme.desc: Госпожа Фазилет после того, как потеряла мужа, одна воспитывает двух дочек. Вся жизнь Фазилет прошла в сожалениях, поэтому теперь ее вкладом в будущее стала младшая дочь Эдже. Но самым большим препятствием на пути матери является старшая дочь Хазан, которая несмотря на свою изысканную красоту ведет себя по-мальчишески и не ладит с матерью. Семья Эймен богата, могущественна, у них особняк на берегу Босфора, и однажды их пути пересекаются с Фазилет и ее дочерьми. Богатство Эймен даже превосходит мечты Фазилет. После знакомства с ними изменится не только жизнь Эдже, но и Хазан, которая влюбится в Синана Эймена, избалованного сына семьи.

programme.desc: Лидер в той или иной сфере общественной жизни - человек известный и информированный - под перекрестным огнем вопросов ведущих программы Михаила Соколова и Елены Рыковцевой.

programme.title: Ольга
programme.desc: Главная героиня воспитывает двух детей от разных браков, заботится об отце-алкоголике и пытается наладить личную жизнь. Старшая дочь Анька учится в ПТУ, думает, что она единственный адекватный член семьи и в её жизни все будет по-другому, младший сын Тимофей, чей отец вернулся к первой семье в Азербайджан, считает, что он уже мужчина, хотя ему всего лишь 11 лет, отец Ольги, бывший футболист, крепко выпивает и постоянно врет, а сестра Ленка пытается жить за счет мужчин, в основном — женатых. Вечно спасая родственников от неприятностей, Ольга живет чужой жизнью и редко думает о себе — до тех пор, пока в нее не влюбляется молодой и положительный водитель газели "Ритуал" Гриша.

programme.title: Голое влечение. Польша
programme.desc: Скандальный цикл передач, в которых люди находят потенциальных спутников жизни, обнаженные тела которых им показывают. Затем они должны будут сами раздеться и сделать выбор.

programme.title: Анатомия убийства
programme.desc: Карского приглашают в город, где готовят к постановке его пьесу. Он просит Евгению поехать с ним, заодно и отдохнуть. Однако уже в первый день в театре происходит убийство, и Женя вынуждена начать расследование. История закрученная, но её талант по мельчайшим деталям докапываться до истины помогает местной полиции выйти на преступника. Вскоре в краеведческом музее находят труп девушки, и вновь Евгения помогает в расследовании. А тем временем пьеса готова к премьере, и Карский должен присутствовать на мероприятии. В доме, где им предоставили прекрасные апартаменты, тоже происходят загадочные события. Местный следователь Алина Богомолова очень высоко ценит работу патологоанатома, которая в свой отпуск помогает во всех расследованиях.

programme.title: Ольга
programme.desc: Главная героиня воспитывает двух детей от разных браков, заботится об отце-алкоголике и пытается наладить личную жизнь. Старшая дочь Анька учится в ПТУ, думает, что она единственный адекватный член семьи и в её жизни все будет по-другому, младший сын Тимофей, чей отец вернулся к первой семье в Азербайджан, считает, что он уже мужчина, хотя ему всего лишь 11 лет, отец Ольги, бывший футболист, крепко выпивает и постоянно врет, а сестра Ленка пытается жить за счет мужчин, в основном — женатых. Вечно спасая родственников от неприятностей, Ольга живет чужой жизнью и редко думает о себе — до тех пор, пока в нее не влюбляется молодой и положительный водитель газели "Ритуал" Гриша.

programme.title: CNN Newsroom
programme.desc: CNN Newroom provides the most up to date news as it breaks and is the longest running show on the channel, airing twice a day Monday to Friday and throughout the day over the weekends. CNN has developed a lot since its founding in 1980 by American media proprietor Ted Turner as a 24 hour cable news channel. As an organisation, CNN have won multiple awards, including a network-record six news & documentary Emmy Awards in 2018.

programme.title: Eclipsing Power: Musk, Bezos and the New Space Race
Fareed Zakaria GPS
programme.desc: Weekly public affairs show hosted by an American journalist, political scientist, and author Fareed Zakaria. The show is broadcasted on CNN every Sunday in many countries of the world. The "GPS" in the show's title stands for "Global Public Square," a reference to the show's focus on international issues and foreign affairs. The guests of the show's one-on-one interviews and roundtable discussions are most prominent figures in the world of global politics, economy and global decision-makers and influencers.

programme.title: African Voices Playmakers
programme.desc: Playmakers. World Cup Footballers. Former footballers from South Africa, Nigeria, and Ghana reflect on their World Cup experiences and show how they're making a difference on the pitch and in their communities.

programme.title: Marketplace Asia
programme.desc: Marketplace Asia on CNN offers unique access to the latest Asian market information, with a look at latest events and developments that impact its business world. Follow the top business stories that influence and shape the Asian continent. Have a look at the interviews with outstanding figures of business and industry and reveal the economic trends in various regions of Asia to get to know the continent's key sectors and corporations.

programme.title: Marketplace Middle East
programme.desc: Business show revolves around cutting edge economic trends and latest business developments in the Middle East. The focus is on the key cities of the region, its most important sectors and industries. The guests of the show are significant representatives of the business community in the region.

programme.title: Connecting Africa
programme.desc: The African continent is going through a big transformation and this CNN magazine presents the entrepreneurs, companies and projects that are working hard to modernise it and make its economic integration possible. Hosted by Eleni Giokos, the episodes bring stories about the fast growing industry, network communication, cross-border trade and increasing trading routes, air connectivity, logistics infrastructure, small businesses and more.

programme.title: Inside Africa
programme.desc: Each week, Inside Africa documentary series on CNN highlights the unique diversity of mysterious Africa, its numerous cultures and religions, peoples, art, music, cuisine, travel and literature, its one-of-a-kind flora and fauna. Watch the interviews with people from various spheres of life and find out more surprising facts about this continent: how it fights for conservation of rare animals, who the new figures in fashion and design are, what the new educational programs for children look like. Everything what Africa is filled with and lives for is in this series.

programme.title: Erin Burnett OutFront
programme.desc: Hosted by Erin Burnett, an expert in political science and economics, OutFront is an hour-long news programme examining the latest stories from the US and further afield. Broadcast live from either the New York studio or live on location from the site of a breaking story, the show features insightful opinions from informed guests. With expert analysis from CNN's correspondents and analysis from the show's panel, Erin Burnett OutFront dissects the stories of the day, leaving no stone unturned. Burnett, a former financial analyst for Goldman Sachs, uses her forthright approach to engage interviewees in honest discussion.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The kids try to help Dad bond with Frankie. / When the uncomfortableness between them reaches new levels Gumball and Hot Dog Guy decide they have to confront their ongoing awkwardness by making things as awkward as possible. / The kids realise that they've never known their neighbour's name, and they're way past the window where they can ask. / Gumball has something uncomfortable to tell Penny but doesn't know how, until he makes a deal with Principal Brown. / Gumball and Anais go head to head in a leadership election voted for by their classmates. / Clayton realises he can imitate his classmates, and begins stealing the lives of the people of Elmore. / When unexpected couples in the world of Elmore start randomly falling in love, Gumball and Darwin have to figure out what's going on. / Gumball questions Mr Small's eco-friendly commitment, causing him to abandon society and live in the forest. Director: Mic Graves.

programme.title: Craig of the Creek
programme.desc: Animated comedy following the adventures of Craig and his two friends Kelsey and JP. When Craig's mother tells him about the bits of his childhood that he does not remember, he feels that he will forget things when he gets older, so he, Kelsey and JP decide to convert their stump into a time capsule and have Bobby guard it for ten years. programme.title: Craig of the Creek

programme.title: Craig of the Creek
programme.desc: Craig and his two best friends, Kelsey and JP, are always going on adventures in the untamed suburban wilderness known as the Creek - a kid utopia where tribes of children rule over tree forts and bike ramps, making up an entire kid society. programme.title: Craig of the Creek

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

The viewers who are not yet familiar with Japan will put it on their bucket list and eventually come to visit and see the one-of-a-kind localities themselves.

programme.title: Kälimehed
programme.desc: Telelavastuse tegevus toimub ühe vaikse Eesti linnakese vaiksel kõrvaltänaval. Vaikelu saab aga rikutud, kui Urmase ja Riina kõrvalmajja kolib Riina õde Rebekka koos oma uue mehe Raivoga. Saatuse tahtel naabriteks ja kälimeesteks saanud Urmas ja Raivo on inimestena erinevad ning nende õdedest elukaaslased omavahel nagistanud lapsest saadik. Lavastuses näeme, kuidas üleaedsed peavad lahendama igale eestlasele nii tuttavaid probleeme naabrite läbikäimises ning mismoodi aitavad sellele kaasa õdede ellu sekkuv ema ning Raivo hämaravõitu äripartner Viks. programme.title: Kättemaksukontor
programme.desc: Fridat valdavad vastuolulised tunded: kas ta on armunud mõrvarisse või on tegu asjaolude kahetsusväärse kokkulangemisega? Ka Marion leiab endale silmarõõmu. Suhete sasipuntra taustal aga hõreneb märkimisväärse järjekindlusega proua Amalie pärijate ring.

programme.title: Kerge elu
programme.desc: Toomas ja tema naine Stella elavad koos oma kahe teismelise lapsega pealtnäha unistuste elu. Keegi ei või arvatagi, et pereisal on minevikust kahe miljoni suurune käendusvõlg ja et seda peret hoitakse üleval ainult kuritegevusega. Kui aga Toomasele tuleb pakkumine osaleda suures raharöövis, ei aima veel keegi, kui halvasti asjad minema hakkavad. Osades Margus Prangel, Helena Merzin, Mirjam Aimla ja Siim Sups. Režissöör Raoul Suvi, stsenarist Mikko Pölla.

programme.title: Lõks
programme.desc: Politsei saab vihje elurajooni garaažikompleksi peidetud tapetud naisest. Kohale saabunud uurijad lõikavad lahti luku ja leiavadki kilesse mässitud naise, sealt kust juhatud. Lisaks on sinna ladustatud ka salakaupa. Järgmine loogiline külaskäik on garaaži omaniku juurde, kes kaotab närvid ning ei anna ammendavaid selgitusi kummagi kohta. Eelmises osas kõigi üllatuseks arreteeritud Alex vabastatakse Leevikese käsul ning sisejuurdlus saab jätkuda. Garaažimõrvas kahtlustatu kohta selgub uus tõend, mis näitab asju selgemalt kui alguses. Alex jõuab kurjategijast kolleegi jälile ning avastab veel ühe laiba. Suur segadus ja klaperjaht omade seas leiab dramaatilise lõpplahenduse.

programme.title: Mõrvaennetajad
programme.desc: Avahooajal USAs laineid löönud põnevussari salapärasest miljardärist, kes värbab endale appi endise CIA agendi, et ühiselt ennetada New Yorki ähvardavaid ränki kuritegusid. Pururikas geenius Finch ("Teadmata kadunud" staar Michael Emerson) on välja töötanud arvutiprogrammi, mis suudab tuvastada potentsiaalse mõrvari või tema ohvri veel enne selle kuriteo reaalset toimumist. Endine eriagent Reese (Jim Caviezel), kes pärast isiklikku tragöödiat elab New Yorkis kodutuna, on nõus Fichiga kampa lööma ja aitab Finchil huvipakkuva isiku üles leida. Reese'i ülesandeks jääb ka tulevase tapja kahjutuks tegemine. Loomulikult peab tandem tegutsema ülima saladuskatte all, sest nende info ja tegevuse paljastamise tagajärjed oleksid katastroofilised.

programme.title: Chicago politseijaoskond
programme.desc: Pärast seda, kui ebaõnnestunud autokaaperdamine osutub millekski enamaks, astub Voighti üksus vastamisi nutika narkoparuniga, kes töötab ainult naistega. Äsja värvatud Vanessa Rojas maadleb üleminekuga salaoperatsioonidelt luureüksusesse.

programme.title: Vendade Hardyde müsteeriumid

programme.title: Rängad kuriteod
programme.desc: Tiim töötab strateegiliselt tabamaks sarimõrvarit, kes on kõik ärevile ajanud. Püüdes juhtumit kiiresti lahendada, on Raydor kahe pealtnäha õige otsuse vahel, millel on mõlemal tõsised tagajärjed. Rusty saab suurema vabaduse, aga uued ähvardused hoiavad teda kodu ligidal.

programme.title: Monk

Endine eriagent Reese (Jim Caviezel), kes pärast isiklikku tragöödiat elab New Yorkis kodutuna, on nõus Fichiga kampa lööma ja aitab Finchil huvipakkuva isiku üles leida. Reese'i ülesandeks jääb ka tulevase tapja kahjutuks tegemine. Loomulikult peab tandem tegutsema ülima saladuskatte all, sest nende info ja tegevuse paljastamise tagajärjed oleksid katastroofilised.

programme.title: Kurjuse kannul
programme.desc: FBI kõige kogenumatest uurijatest ning profileerijatest koostatud meeskond lahendab ränki kuritegusid, mis esmapilgul tunduvad väljapääsmatult keerukad. Meeskonna iga liige on oma valdkonna tipp ning üksteist täendades pole ükski kuritegu neile lahendamatu.

programme.title: Chicago politseijaoskond
programme.desc: Pärast seda, kui ebaõnnestunud autokaaperdamine osutub millekski enamaks, astub Voighti üksus vastamisi nutika narkoparuniga, kes töötab ainult naistega. Äsja värvatud Vanessa Rojas maadleb üleminekuga salaoperatsioonidelt luureüksusesse.

programme.title: Ratastel Las Vegasesse
programme.desc: Veidrikust ajakirjanik ja tema psühhopaadist jurist reisivad Las Vegasesse, ajades taga erinevaid psühhedeelilisi kogemusi.

programme.title: Wayne'i maailm
programme.desc: Film põhineb saate Saturday Night Live samanimelisel sketšil. Napakas ja kõiki piire kompavas popkultuuri-komöödias järgitakse armsalt sihitute heavy-meeste Wayne'i ja Garthi seiklusi.

programme.title: Hormoonid, stringid ja kõvad banaanid
programme.desc: Tüdruk peab päevikut teismeea murede ja rõõmude kohta ning ühtlasi kirjutab üles kõik, mida ta suudlemise kohta teada saab.

programme.title: Daam kaubikus
programme.desc: Noor kirjanik Alan pakub autos elavale vanaprouale parkimiskohta oma maja sissesõiduteel. Ajutine lahendus venib aga 15 aasta pikkuseks kummaliseks koosluseks, mille käigus mees avastab, et tema ellu on tekkinud lisaks virgutavalt nõudlikule emale ka tulise loomuga ja pesemist pelgav vanaema.

programme.title: Kas me oleme juba valmis?
programme.desc: Perepea otsustab kolida naise ja lastega ahistavast suurlinna keskelt äärelinna, ent maja, millest pidi saama nende unistuste kodu, kipub ümbert ära lagunema!

programme.title: Eriliselt kangelaslik film
programme.desc: Üks tavaline abiturient omandab ootamatult üleloomulikud võimed. Endine hädavares, kes on loomult heatahtlik ja abivalmis, otsustab hakata superkangelaseks. Nüüd hakkab ta võitlema kurjusega.

programme.title: Adam Sandleri kaheksa hullu ööd
programme.desc: Karistusregistriga alkohoolik Davey Stone'ile määratakse ühiskondlik töö vanemapoolse kohtuniku järelevalve all. Davey püüab end muuta ja halvad harjumused maha jätta.

programme.title: Peeter Pikk-kõrv
programme.desc: Põlvkondi lugejaid võlunud üleannetu ja seiklusjanuline kangelane Peeter Pikk-kõrv on sel korral peaosatäitja omaenda särtsakas tänapäevases komöödias. Peetri vaen hr McGregoriga (Domnhall Gleeson) jõuab filmis uuele tasemele, kui nad asuvad konkureerima naabermajas elava südamliku loomaarmastaja (Rose Byrne) tunnete pärast.

programme.title: Tagasi Maa peal
programme.desc: Mustanahaline koomik sureb enne õiget aega ning saab valge ärimehe kehas uue võimaluse.

programme.title: Eriliselt kangelaslik film
programme.desc: Üks tavaline abiturient omandab ootamatult üleloomulikud võimed. Endine hädavares, kes on loomult heatahtlik ja abivalmis, otsustab hakata superkangelaseks. Nüüd hakkab ta võitlema kurjusega.

programme.title: Troopiline kõu
programme.desc: Kamp näitlejaid läheb eemale argielust ja üritab the suure-eelarvelist filmi Vietnami sõjast, kuni neid kistakse päris sõjaseisukorda. Jeff "Fats" Portnoy(Jack Black) on ülekaaluline koomik, kes üritab lahti saada oma narkosõltuvusest samal ajal dzunglis uut filmi tehes; Kirk Lazarus (Robert Downey Jr.) on oma generatsiooni parim näitleja, kes on võitnud 4 Oscarit; Kevin Sandusky (Jay Baruchel) on tundmatu näitleja filmipaigas; Tud Speedman(Ben Stiller) on aga poputatud action-staar, kes tahab hakata "tõsiseks" näitlejaks. Nad peavad panema on võimed proovile, et pääseda sõjast ja seda muidugi väga humoorikalt.

programme.title: Zack ja Miri teevad porri
programme.desc: Zack (Rogen) ja Miri (Banks) on lapsepõlvest saati head sõbrad olnud. Täiskasvanuna otsustavad nad ka kokku kolida. Kõik näib minevat hästi, kuid arved tahavad maksmist ja üür tasumist ning noortel hakkavad tekkima rahamured. Nii otsustavadki nad raha saamiseks teha pornofilmi. Kaamerate ees olles selgub, et neil on teineteise vastu rohkem tundeid kui nad arvata oleks osanud. Film ei sobi alaealistele.

programme.title: Lõputu küünlapäev
programme.desc: R: Harold Ramis. O: Bill Murray, Andie MacDowell. Ilmateadustaja Phil (Bill Murray) saadetakse igal aastal 2. veebruaril Pennsylvania osariigis asuvasse Punxsutawney väikelinna, et teha seal reportaaž ilma ennustavast metsümisejast. Kui metsümiseja näeb urust väljudes oma varju, kestab talv veel kuus nädalat, kui ei näe, tuleb kevad varakult. Juhtub aga, et lumetormi tõttu jääb Phil koos võttemeeskonnaga Punxsutawneysse vangi. Järgmisel hommikul ärgates märkab ta oma suureks üllatuseks, et kõik eelmisel päeval toimunu kordub uuesti. Tundub, et sellest päevast kujuneb Phili jaoks eksistentsiaalne luupainaja, kuni ta taipab, et ajas tagasi rändamine annab talle võimaluse õppida tundma produtsenti Ritat (Andie MacDowell).

programme.title: Kas me oleme juba kohal?
programme.desc: Noormees tutvub kaunitariga, kes osutub kahe lapsega lahutatud üksikemaks. Lapsed on kategooriliselt ema potentsiaalse poiss-sõbra vastu. Nende ettekujutustes peaks ema nende isaga kokku jääma.
